items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The 4-line addition matches the reference exactly. The comment explains why ('parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth') and the formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Minimal, contained change inside prepend_scheme_if_needed that reuses parse_url's existing auth field. No new helpers, no dead code, no debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The 'if auth:' guard skips URLs without credentials. No exception handling is needed, there are no magic constants, and hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: Signature unchanged. Only adds netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc]) when auth is present, so URLs without auth behave as before. No urllib3 pinning or Python-version check. Auth is passed through as-is, with no re-encoding.
